How eSIMFlys works
A travel eSIM is a digital SIM you install by scanning a QR code â no physical card, no swapping, no roaming bills. Here's the whole process.
1. Choose your plan
Pick a destination from 68 countries and select the data amount and validity that fit your trip.
2. Receive your QR code
After checkout we email you an eSIM QR code, usually within minutes.
3. Scan & install
Open your phone's settings, add an eSIM, and scan the QR code. Install before you travel while on Wi-Fi.
